summary: classes_search/classes_catalog declare duration, super_genre_id, has_workout, and is_favorite_ride (the last two tri-state: omitted/true/false are distinct queries) alongside classes_filters' vocabulary, and makeAPIHandlerStripFields logs any still-undeclared forwarded argument name to stderr. A future regen of this endpoint pair must keep these four bindings declared and keep the stderr logging wired into the forwarding loop, and must keep tools-manifest.json's param list for both tools in sync with the runtime schema.
reason: These filters already worked via the existing raw-argument passthrough, but were undiscoverable from the tool schema, and a misspelled raw filter name silently returned unfiltered results instead of erroring.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New tests cover the declared schema types, the undeclared-argument classification helper, and that stderr logging fires only for genuinely undeclared args.
